contexts.text: Pairs of all shalt thou make to enter into the ark to vivify () = their regeneration... to wit, both of truths... and of goods... AC 673. (Compare AC 717.)
They cannot be pairs unless they correspond to each other, as do truths and goods, and evils and falsities, Explained.

In order that love and wisdom may make a one with angel and with man, there are pairs in all things of his body. Enumerated... All their right parts relate to love, from which is wisdom, and all their left parts to wisdom from love... Angel and man have these pairs, in order that love and wisdom, or good and truth, may act a one; and that as a one they may look to the Lord.
In the other things of the body, which are called members, organs, and viscera, the will and understanding are conjoined, and therefore they are in pairs. Enumerated.

And as the conjunction of good and truth is reciprocal, and, through this conjunction there is effected as it were a one, therefore these pairs in man act together and conjointly in functions, motions, and senses.

From this marriage (of the will and understanding) it is that in each and all things of the body there is a right and a left; and the right relates to the good from which is truth; and the left to the truth from good; thus to conjunction. It is from this that there are pairs in man. Enumerated.
A pair of consorts (from the Third Heaven). Described.
Hence it is provided that conjugial pairs are born... CL 316:3.

The three pairs of birds (seen) signify these things: the pair of turtle-doves, the conjugial love of the highest region (of the mind); the pair of birds of paradise, the conjugial love of the middle region: and the pair of swans, the conjugial love of the lowest region.

In like manner the rest of the pairs with man relate to good and truth; the organ or member on the right, to good; and the one on the left to truth. It is the like with a husband and his wife between whom there is love truly conjugial...

(These consorts who are in such conjugial love that both can be one flesh) are like the pairs in man (Enumerated) which, although they are two, still are one as to life, and as to the exercises of life, which are uses.
Hence it is that here and elsewhere in the Word, pairs are mentioned, of which the one signifies good, and the other truth. Example(s).
